_ordering_rationale: PV decroissante : ITS revenue (segment majoritaire ~80% CA, compresseurs leader mondial), PST revenue (segment haute croissance via acquisitions), ITS EBITDA (cash machine du groupe), PST EBITDA (marges premium).

kpis.signal: Segment majoritaire ~80% CA, leader mondial compresseurs/pompes industrielles
kpis.description_fr: Segment ITS : compresseurs, pompes industrielles, vide. ~80% du CA Ingersoll Rand FY24. Aftermarket 39.9% du CA segment (recurrent).
kpis.description_en: ITS segment: compressors, industrial pumps, vacuum. ~80% Ingersoll Rand revenue FY24. Aftermarket 39.9% of segment revenue (recurring).

kpis.signal: Segment hypercroissance via M&A (ILC Dover 2024), marges premium ~30%
kpis.description_fr: Segment PST : pompes precision life sciences, medical, labo. Croissance forte via acquisitions strategiques (ILC Dover 1.4Mds$ goodwill 2024).
kpis.description_en: PST segment: precision pumps for life sciences, medical, lab. Strong growth via strategic M&A (ILC Dover $1.4B goodwill 2024).

kpis.signal: Marge EBITDA ajustee 30.2%, +200bps YoY, cash machine du groupe
kpis.description_fr: EBITDA ajuste segment ITS. Marge 30.2% FY24 (+200bps YoY), portee par pricing, productivite et acquisitions. Cash machine finance le M&A.
kpis.description_en: ITS Adjusted EBITDA. 30.2% margin FY24 (+200bps YoY), driven by pricing, productivity, and acquisitions. Cash machine funding M&A.

kpis.signal: Marge EBITDA ~29.6% (premium vs industrie), expose au life sciences
kpis.description_fr: EBITDA ajuste segment PST. Marge 29.6% FY24, en legere baisse (-40bps) car mix integration ILC Dover.
kpis.description_en: PST Adjusted EBITDA. 29.6% margin FY24, slight decrease (-40bps) due to ILC Dover integration mix.

_notes: Historique 5 ans FY20-FY24. Sources 10-K SEC Ingersoll Rand sections 'Segment Results'. Valeurs auditees disclosed dans le MD&A. ITS aftermarket recurrent et PST acquisitions = drivers de PV.
